newsitem.title: USA: Integrated files for 1.5 mln shr offer.
newsitem.headline: Integrated files for 1.5 mln shr offer.

text.p: Integrated Measurement Systems Inc said on Friday it plans to file a registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission the week of January 27 for an underwritten public offering of 1.5 million common shares.
The company said it expects to sell 675,000 shares and that it expects shareholders to sell 825,000 shares.
It also said it expects underwriters will be given an option to buy another 225,000 shares for over-allotments, if any.
